name: IntegrateIT Color Integration
notes: A headless color engine for Control4 lighting: give it a color as hex, HSV, Kelvin, or CIE xy and it maps it to the light-proxy color parameters (CIE 1931 xy plus a full-color or color-temperature mode), clamps it into the chosen gamut, ramps it over a transition, and publishes every step as variables and events for programming to apply. MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
